onboardingPage.noDate: No date picked. That's okay, you can skip this.
onboardingPage.pushOn: Notifications are on. You'll only get gentle reminders.
onboardingPage.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in this browser. You can allow them in the browser's site settings, then turn them on in Settings.
onboardingPage.pushOff: No problem. You can turn notifications on later in Settings.
onboardingPage.pushUnsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Your check-ins will still be waiting for you in chat.
onboardingPage.pushNotConfigured: Notifications aren't ready yet. You can turn them on later in Settings.
onboardingPage.pushNeedsInstall: On iPhone, notifications work after you add Companion to your Home Screen:
onboardingPage.installTitle: Keep Companion on your home screen
onboardingPage.installBody: Add it like an app. It opens full screen and is one tap away whenever you want to talk.
onboardingPage.androidStep1: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
onboardingPage.androidStep2: Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
onboardingPage.iosStep1: Open this site in Safari and tap the Share button (the square with an arrow).
onboardingPage.iosStep3: Open Companion from the new icon on your Home Screen.
